To show deals in pounds:

1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**.
2. Choose **GBP** as the **Currency**.
3. Select **Save client profile**.

Note: this changes the symbol shown on every deal but doesn't convert existing values. To update an amount, open the deal in **Deals**, select **Edit**, enter the new number in **Value** (numbers only, no symbol) and select **Save deal**.
